name: Adolescence
description: When a 13-year-old is accused of the murder of a classmate, his family, therapist and the detective in charge are all left asking: what really happened?

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Police break down the door of the Millers' family home. Teenage Jamie is arrested and taken in for questioning but insists he's done nothing wrong.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: The police look for answers — and the weapon — at Jamie's school. They can't get any leads from his friends, until DI Bascombe's son offers to help.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Jamie meets with a psychologist. He's reluctant to speak at first, but eventually he opens up about his complex feelings towards Katie.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: On Eddie's birthday, the Millers try to celebrate like everything is normal. But a series of upsetting events threatens to send the family over the edge.

awards: Won 8 Primetime Emmys. 60 wins & 73 nominations total
